question: On the off chance that Subaru not only insulted the knights at the royal selection, but the Master Swordsman as well, never might Reinhard, what sort of punishment would Old Man Wil have dropped on him?
answer: Wilhelm wasn’t there, so nothing at all. He’d have smiled and let it pass as the rambling of a youngster, however I can’t say for sure that Reinhard would have let it pass.
